name: PT Soho Global Health Tbk
summary: PT Soho Global Health Tbk, together with its subsidiaires, operates as a healthcare company in Indonesia. It operates through Distributions, Consumer Health, Alliance, and Others segments. The company researches, develops, and markets specialty-focused medicines for use in the therapeutic areas of immunomodulator, respiratory, inflammation, and liver diseases; offers nonprescription brand products to treat and prevent diseases; and distribution and logistics services.
